# TheBoatGuy.dk

> TheBoatGuy.dk is a boat care company serving Denmark, South Sweden and North Germany. It is run by two co-founders who do all the work themselves. Services: gelcoat sanding and polishing, full bottom treatment, bottom painting (antifouling), interior cleaning, exterior cleaning and washing, and teak cleaning. 11+ years of experience; all work carries a workmanship guarantee.

TheBoatGuy.dk (Danish: bådpleje, bådpolering, bundmaling, bundbehandling) is based at Bella Center, 2300 København S, Denmark. The site is in Danish and English.

## Services

- Gelcoat sanding & polishing: restoration, surface correction, polishing and high-gloss finishing with ceramic protection.
- Full bottom treatment: sanding down to gelcoat, removing old antifouling and primer, and applying new primer layers and antifouling.
- Bottom painting (antifouling): light sanding and preparation of the bottom, followed by the application of a new antifouling coat.
- Interior cleaning: thorough and professional cleaning of the boat's interior.
- Exterior cleaning & washing: complete exterior wash and care, including window cleaning and drying of the entire boat.
- Teak cleaning: deep cleaning of teak in two to three steps.

## Service area

- Denmark
- South Sweden
- North Germany

## Pricing

There is no price list or online calculator. Once the customer has provided the vessel's details and current condition, TheBoatGuy.dk prepares a proposed scope of work and a preliminary estimate.

## How it works

1. Send the boat's details and current condition.
2. Receive a proposed scope of work and a preliminary estimate.
3. The two co-founders do the work.
4. A final inspection is done together with the customer before handover.

## Frequently asked questions

- How do I get a price? Provide the vessel's details and current condition via the quote form; a proposed scope of work and a preliminary estimate follow.
- Is the work guaranteed? Yes, all work carries a workmanship guarantee.
- What do you need to know about the boat? Make and model, length, harbour and current condition. Photos help.
